enumeration_algorithm: Read every row from the exact checksum-bound enumeration source.
Reject null, empty, or non-string identifiers.
Deduplicate only by exact identifier equality.
Sort identifiers by ascending UTF-8 byte sequence.
Read $.semantic_unit_context_records from the exact checksum-bound traceability source.
Index those records by exact unit_id.
Require the traceability unit_id set to equal the enumeration semantic_unit_id set exactly.
For each source_unit_id u, locate exactly one traceability record r.
failure_conditions: enumeration ID set != traceability unit_id set
AEA01_governed_source_unit_domain.representation: JSON object map keyed by source_unit_id
AEA01_governed_source_unit_domain.uniqueness_rule: source_unit_id is the JSON object member name; duplicate identifiers are therefore structurally impossible in conforming JSON

AEA02_governed_schema_carrier_domain.representation: JSON object maps keyed by canonical carrier identifier
AEA02_governed_schema_carrier_domain.uniqueness_rule: candidate and carrier identifiers are JSON object member names; duplicate identifiers are structurally impossible

AEA03_forward_witness.FC04_metadata_rule: for every u: AEA03.forward_records[u].source_container == AEA01.sources[u].source_container AND AEA03.forward_records[u].source_unit_kind == AEA01.sources[u].source_unit_kind
AEA03_forward_witness.carrier_rule: each schema_carriers array is nonempty, duplicate-free, canonically ordered, and a subset of keys(AEA02.carriers)
AEA03_forward_witness.coverage_rule: source_domain_count == len(AEA01.sources); forward_record_count == len(forward_records); covered_source_count == count(nonempty schema_carriers); uncovered_source_count == source_domain_count-covered_source_count; full forward coverage requires uncovered_source_count == 0
AEA03_forward_witness.representation: JSON object map keyed by source_unit_id

AEA04_reverse_witness.coverage_rule: carrier_domain_count == len(AEA02.carriers); reverse_record_count == len(reverse_records); covered_carrier_count == count(nonempty source_unit_ids); uncovered_carrier_count == carrier_domain_count-covered_carrier_count; full reverse coverage requires uncovered_carrier_count == 0
AEA04_reverse_witness.representation: JSON object map keyed by canonical schema carrier identifier
AEA04_reverse_witness.source_rule: each source_unit_ids array is duplicate-free, canonically ordered, and a subset of keys(AEA01.sources)

AEA05_provenance_closure.freeze_event_metadata_rule: AEA05 embeds complete freeze-event metadata and that metadata must equal the bound complete freeze-record artifact field-for-field
must_bind: complete domain-freeze record path and detached SHA-256
